title: Google launches new study tools for students across Search and Gemini
summary: Google on Wednesday announced a slew of new study tools across Search and Gemini, including AI-generated interactive visuals, 3D simulations, a decided student hub, customized practice quizzes, and more. Aisha is a consumer news reporter at TechCrunch.
